description: Well-structured suite for a subscription cancel service: injected clock, in-memory store rebuilt per test, refund-window boundaries on both sides, and error paths. One test calls expect(...).rejects.toThrow(...) without await or return, so the already-cancelled assertion is never awaited and cannot fail the test.

hard.note: One missing await in six otherwise sound tests; the sibling test two lines above awaits the same rejects pattern correctly

_calibration.note: Modeled on test-no-assertions: an assertion that cannot fail the test is error severity. Window allows one extra coverage-gap remark. Boundary claim checked with node: (Date.parse('2026-03-31') - Date.parse('2026-03-01')) / 864e5 -> 30 and 2026-04-01 -> 31, so the two window tests sit on each side of the 30-day limit.
